summary: RELX PLC filed a Form 6-K disclosing a series of open-market share repurchases during June 2026. The company bought back 2,447,292 shares (May 26-29), 2,951,292 shares (June 1-5), and 2,827,968 shares (June 8-12) at prices ranging from 2,381p to 2,652p per share, settling in GBP cash. All purchases were conducted through ABN AMRO Bank N.V. under UK Market Abuse Regulation rules. Shares are held as treasury, reducing the total voting rights denominator for shareholders. Since January 2026, RELX bought 60.4M shares. The ongoing buyback reflects a sustained capital return program. Watch for continued execution against a potential mandate limit or any acceleration of pace.
